title: DFB-Pokal winners 2017 to 2026
brief: Name the club that won the DFB-Pokal final in each year from 2017 to 2026.

notes.Bayern Munich: Bayern won 3 of these finals (2019, 2020, 2026); they also won in 2016 and lost the 2018 final to Eintracht Frankfurt.
notes.Wolfsburg: Wolfsburg won in 2015, just outside this window.
notes.Freiburg: Freiburg lost the 2022 final to RB Leipzig on penalties.
notes.Kaiserslautern: Kaiserslautern lost the 2024 final to Leverkusen.
notes.Arminia Bielefeld: Arminia Bielefeld lost the 2025 final to Stuttgart.

checks: Winners from Wikipedia's list of finals match Transfermarkt's list of winners for every final from 2001 to 2026. Bayern fill 3 slots here, so the 4-slot rule passes. Windows were tested from 2001: every window starting 2001 to 2014 gives Bayern 4 or more slots; windows starting 2015, 2016 and 2017 pass, and only the latest (2017 to 2026) is written, as the other two overlap it by eight or nine years.
